source.title: Generalizable long short-term memory models for beef cattle DMI under grazing

observedDataAvailabilityStatement: Data may be available by contacting the corresponding author.

accessAssessment.status: article is public to read; underlying individual records are not an open downloadable dataset based on the publisher's current data availability statement

relevance.populationAndSystem: beef cattle in drylot and grazing cohorts; the paper's cattle are Bos taurus or Bos taurus-derived crossbreds in finishing-stage systems
relevance.validationNote: The article describes held-out validation including grazing, but its records are not openly downloadable and its reported model performance is not validation of Agroville.
limitsForAgroville: Does not provide an openly licensed microdata file for independent reproduction.
DMI alone cannot calibrate ADG, costs, pasture stock, or the full pasture-versus-confinement engine outputs.
The described finishing-stage population is not a mature cow-calf population or the approved USDA/CPER cohort.

action: Do not download or reconstruct individual observations from the article. Prioritize audited public datasets; reconsider only if a data deposit with compatible terms becomes available.
limitations: This audit records the publisher's data statement and a bounded search for a linked public repository; it does not prove that no separate repository exists anywhere.
The data availability statement permits asking the corresponding author, but does not itself grant access or a reuse license.
